review.reason: The illustration preserves the overall course layout, uses continuous natural-looking greens, and shows clear mowing stripes. However, Hole 1's mapped tee is not visible, and trees crowd the tee-to-landing corridor in that area.

issues.detail: The mapped T1 tee marker is missing; the corresponding central area shows trees and rough instead.
issues.consequence: The overview does not show where Hole 1 begins, making its tee-to-green routing harder to read.

issues.detail: Added tree crowns and shadows crowd the mapped T1-to-first-fairway landing corridor beside the central fairway.
issues.consequence: The Hole 1 carry appears visually obstructed, which can make the overview misleading about the open route shown in the approved geometry.
